answer: Identities are free; pay only verified marginal effect. Each reward claim cites a measurable delta on an objective task, and sampled spot-checkers must re-run it; credit then sets like marble in the ledger. Extra aliases split one operator's demonstrated effect; a glacier of clones with no delta earns zero. Assumption: honest verifier sampling and rewards priced near production cost; this blocks cheap amplification, not genuinely larger funded compute.
